entries.back_en: "Who dares enter the sacred domains of my Lord?"
"I am the guardian of this place. I command thee to leave, intruder, before thy life pays the price."
"Can it be? Do my eyes see truth?"
"Majesty! You have returned!"
"My lord... The mortals that followed you on the throne... They degrade you with each passing generation..."
"Truly I feared they would not fulfill their promise. It gladdens my heart to see you restored to your place, my lord."
"The promise must be fulfilled. Once more I shall ascend to godhood over this world..."
"M... Majesty!?"
"You... You survived even of the Carronade!?"
entries.note: 'até da Carronade' é agramatical; usar 'até à Carronade'.

entries.back_en: "I... Now that your power has returned, Majesty, none of us can match you (plural)."
entries.note: 'a voces' (plural) inconsistente com 'vosso'; deveria ser 'a vós'.

entries.back_en: "Didst thou truly believe thou couldst defeat me? That thou couldst kill a god?"
"Forgive my words, Majesty, but the current Emperor, Soniel..."
"I knew when I accepted this mission that there would be a steep price. One does not lightly undertake such a task as to kill a god."
"Though an old man's life may not be enough to atone for what we have done, still I offer it."
"For it is the nature of mortals that they pass quickly through this world. This time comes to all of us -- it is up to us only to choose when and how."
"I see now that you are the other half of my lord."
"I shall take you to the Castle, where my lord awaits you."
The Imperial Castle "M... Majesty!?"
"Please forgive my earlier actions."
